rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something unimportant or of little significance.

example.english: These details are trivial, so there is no need to think about them anymore.
example.traditional: 呢啲細節唔重要，唔使再諗喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 sai3 zit3 m4 zung6 jiu3 m4 sai2 zoi3 nam2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for petty everyday matters that are trivial and not worth worrying about.

example.english: You should not argue over these trivial matters.
example.traditional: 你哋唔好為咗呢啲雞毛蒜皮嘅事嘈交。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 wai6 zo2 ni1 di1 gai1 mou4 syun3 pei4 ge3 si6 cou4 gaau1

rows.note: Use this more formal wording when stressing that something has negligible significance or value.

example.english: This expense is trivial in relation to the entire plan.
example.traditional: 對整個計劃嚟講，呢筆開支微不足道。
example.jyutping: deoi3 zing2 go3 gai3 waak6 lai4 gong2 ne1 bat1 hoi1 zi1 mei4 bat1 zuk1 dou6
